name: AMD
rationale: AMD committed $1B to Meta's October 2026 equity offering per AMD's own 2026-10-27 release (widely cited, e.g. https://www.vermoegenszentrum.ch/en/stock-exchange-and-markets/news/advanced-micro-devices-invest-usd1-billion-meta-equity-offer), announced alongside NVIDIA's $3B commitment to the same raise and tied to AMD's Helios rack-scale systems going live at Meta. Not currently on the corporate watchlist; now co-investing alongside tracked strategics in hyperscaler capital raises (Meta also flagged non-binding interest from Broadcom in the same raise, but that is unconfirmed/non-binding so not listed here as its own row).
